info.name: Composio Platform Account Management Connected Accounts API
List connected accounts with optional filters

params.name: toolkit_slugs
params.description: The toolkit slugs of the connected accounts

params.name: statuses
params.description: The status of the connected account

params.name: cursor
params.description: The cursor to paginate through the connected accounts

params.name: limit
params.description: The limit of the connected accounts to return

params.name: user_ids
params.description: The user ids of the connected accounts

params.name: auth_config_ids
params.description: The auth config ids of the connected accounts

params.name: connected_account_ids
params.description: The connected account ids to filter by

params.name: order_by
params.description: The order by of the connected accounts

params.name: order_direction
params.description: The order direction of the connected accounts

params.name: account_type
params.description: [Experimental] Filter by sharing model. Default (omitted) returns PRIVATE only — shared accounts must be requested explicitly. Pass SHARED for only shared accounts, or ALL for PRIVATE + SHARED.

items.docs: Retrieves all connected accounts for your project. Connected accounts represent authenticated user connections to external services (e.g., a user's Gmail account, Slack workspace). Filter by toolkit, status, user ID, or auth config to find specific connections.

Initiates a new connection to an external service for a user. For OAuth-based toolkits, this returns a redirect URL to complete authentication. For API key-based toolkits, provide the credentials directly in the request body. Use the `user_id` field to associate the connection with a specific user in your system.

info.name: Get connected account details by ID

params.name: nanoid
params.description: The unique identifier (nanoid) of the connected account

items.docs: Retrieves comprehensive details of a connected account, including authentication configuration, connection status, and all parameters needed for API requests.

params.name: nanoid
params.description: The unique identifier (nanoid) of the connected account

items.docs: Update a connected account. Supports updating the alias and/or credentials. Only specified fields will be updated. Set a credential field to null to remove it. Alias must be unique within the same project, entity, and toolkit scope.

params.name: nanoid
params.description: The unique identifier (nanoid) of the connected account

items.docs: Soft-deletes a connected account by marking it as deleted in the database. This prevents the account from being used for API calls but preserves the record for audit purposes.

info.name: Enable or disable a connected account

params.name: nanoId
params.description: The unique identifier of the connected account

items.docs: Updates the status of a connected account to either enabled (active) or disabled (inactive). Disabled accounts cannot be used for API calls but remain in the database.

info.name: Refresh authentication for a connected account

params.name: nanoid
params.description: The unique identifier of the connected account

items.docs: Initiates a new authentication flow for a connected account when credentials have expired or become invalid. This may generate a new authentication URL for OAuth flows or refresh tokens for other auth schemes.

info.name: Create a new auth link session

items.docs: Creates a new authentication link session that users can use to connect their accounts

info.name: List active connected toolkits for a consumer user

params.name: user_id
params.description: Consumer user ID to inspect within the consumer project.

items.docs: Resolves the organization's single CONSUMER project and returns the distinct toolkit slugs for which the specified consumer user has an ACTIVE connection.
